config.title: Configuration

keystore.keyring: Keys are stored encrypted (AES-256-GCM); the key that opens them lives in your system's keyring (Windows Credential Manager, macOS Keychain or the desktop keyring on Linux), never in a file.
keystore.passphrase: Keys are stored encrypted (AES-256-GCM); the key that opens them is derived from the passphrase in HYDRA_KEYSTORE_PASSPHRASE and is never written to disk.
keystore.file: Keys are stored encrypted (AES-256-GCM), but this machine has no keyring, so the key that opens them sits in master.key next to the store. That only keeps out other users of this computer; on a server, set HYDRA_KEYSTORE_PASSPHRASE instead.

config.routerModelHint: Reads each main-chat message and picks the agent it goes to. A fast one is best: it does not write the answer, it only hands the message out. If you pick an API model, that message is sent to that provider.

toolsOnDemand.title: Tools on demand
toolsOnDemand.hint: When an agent has more than 12 tools, the model gets an index (name and one line per tool) and loads the full definition only of the ones it is going to use. It cuts the tokens of every call a lot. Tools you name in the message and the ones the chat used in its previous task start loaded.

roundTimeout.title: Longest model answer
roundTimeout.hint: How long the model may take to answer in each round of a task. The clock pauses while the tools run (each connection has its own limit) and restarts on the next round, so a long task of many rounds is not cut; a model that never answers is. Empty: 10 minutes in the cloud, 15 with the local model.
roundTimeout.label: Minutes per round (1 to 25)

calendar.permsHint: Agents add notes freely; scheduling an action, changing or removing an entry asks for your approval. Your entries they may change with approval, never remove.

form.title: Title

detail.outside: Written by an agent that had read outside content: it stays out of the other agents' agenda.
